# cato_users_group (Data Source)

Retrieves users groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
## Providers ###
provider "cato" {
  baseurl    = "https://api.catonetworks.com/api/v1/graphql2"
  token      = var.cato_token
  account_id = var.account_id
}

### Data Source Usage ###

# Example: Read all users groups
data "cato_users_group" "all" {}

# Example: Read users groups by name
data "cato_users_group" "by_name" {
  name_filter = ["Engineering", "Contractors"]
}

# Example: Read only SCIM-provisioned groups
# import_type_filter accepts one of: DYNAMIC, INTEGRATION, LDAP, MANUAL, SCIM
data "cato_users_group" "scim_only" {
  import_type_filter = "SCIM"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `import_type_filter` (String) Filter by group import type (DYNAMIC, INTEGRATION, LDAP, MANUAL, SCIM)
- `name_filter` (List of String) List of group names to filter

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of users groups (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description
- `id` (String) ID
- `import_type` (String) Import type
- `members_count` (Number) Number of members in the group
- `name` (String) Name
